<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const bar = document.querySelector('.asen-line');
  const extraBar = document.querySelector('.asen-line-extra');
  const body = document.body;

  const hasBar = bar && window.getComputedStyle(bar).display !== 'none';
  const hasExtraBar = extraBar && window.getComputedStyle(extraBar).display !== 'none';

  if (hasBar && hasExtraBar) {
    body.classList.add('has-two-bars');
  } else if (hasBar || hasExtraBar) {
    body.classList.add('has-one-bar');
  }
});
</script>

<script>
/* Open on click, never on the focus that a pointer press fires.
   focus runs during mousedown; opening there shows the full-screen overlay
   before mouseup, so the same gesture's click lands on the overlay and the
   panel closes at once. A keyboard focus has no following click, so it may open. */
(function () {
    function ready(fn) {
        if (document.readyState !== 'loading') { fn(); } else { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn); }
    }
    function openSearch(ev) {
        if (!window.aspOpenSearch) { return; }
        window.aspOpenSearch(ev);
    }
    ready(function () {
        var field = document.getElementById('searchInput');
        if (field) {
            var fromPointer = false;
            field.addEventListener('pointerdown', function () { fromPointer = true; });
            field.addEventListener('pointerup', function () {
                setTimeout(function () { fromPointer = false; }, 0);
            });
            field.addEventListener('pointercancel', function () { fromPointer = false; });
            field.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (fromPointer) { return; }
                openSearch();
            });
        }

        /* Mobile magnifier sits outside the form and only slides the theme field
           in. Open our panel on that same click and stop it from bubbling, so the
           outside-click handler does not treat the opener as a click outside. */
        var toggle = document.querySelector('.ds-header-search-toggle-button');
        if (toggle) {
            toggle.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                openSearch(e);
            });
        }
    });
}());
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var root=document.getElementById('language');
  if(!root) return;
  var btn=root.querySelector('#asen-lang-btn');
  var menu=root.querySelector('#asen-lang-menu');
  var form=document.getElementById('form-language');

  function setOpen(v){
    root.classList.toggle('open',v);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', v?'true':'false');
  }

  btn.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    setOpen(!root.classList.contains('open'));
  });

  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(!root.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false);
  });

  root.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='Escape'){ setOpen(false); btn.focus(); }
  });

  menu.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var opt=e.target.closest('.asen-lang__option');
    if(!opt) return;
    form.querySelector('input[name="code"]').value=opt.getAttribute('data-code');
    form.submit();
  });
})();
</script>

(function () {
  var mini = document.getElementById('lang-mini');
  if (!mini) return;

  mini.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest('[data-target-code]');
    if (!btn) return;

    // уже активный – ничего не делаем
    if (btn.classList.contains('is-active')) return;

    var form = document.getElementById('form-language'); // встроенная форма OpenCart
    if (!form) { console.warn('form-language not found'); return; }

    var codeInput = form.querySelector('input[name="code"]');
    if (!codeInput) { console.warn('code input not found'); return; }

    codeInput.value = btn.getAttribute('data-target-code');
    form.submit(); // отправляем POST на common/language/language
  });
})();

<script>
$("#InputSubscribeEmail, #oct-scales-static").on("change paste keyup", function() {
	$(this).removeClass('error_style');
});
$('#footer-make-subscribe').on('click', function() {
	$.ajax({
		type: 'post',
		url:  'index.php?route=octemplates/module/oct_subscribe/makeSubscribe',
		dataType: 'json',
		cache: false,
		data: $('#footer-subscribe').serialize(),
		success: function(json) {
			if (json['error']) {
				$('#us-subscribe-modal .text-danger').remove();
				let errorOption = '';

				$.each(json['error'], function(i, val) {
					$('#footer-subscribe [name="' + i + '"]').addClass('error_style');
					errorOption += '<div class="alert-text-item">' + val + '</div>';
				});

				scNotify('danger', errorOption);
			} else {
				if (json['output']) {
					$('#footer-subscribe [name="email"]').val('');
					scNotify('success', '<div class="alert-text-item">' + json['output'] + '</div>');
					footerSubscribeClose();
					$('#footer-subscribe [name="agree"]').prop('checked', false);
				}
			}
		}
	});
});
</script>

<script>
function get_oct_policy() {
	$.ajax({
		url: "index.php?route=octemplates/main/oct_functions/getOctPolicy",
		type: "post",
		dataType: "json",
		cache: false,
		success: function(t) {
			if (t['text_oct_policy']) {
				var html = '<div id="oct-policy" class="fixed-bottom py-4"><div class="container"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-12"><div class="content-block-p24 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between flex-column flex-md-row"><div class="oct-policy-text dark-text fsz-14 mb-3 mb-md-0 me-md-4">'+ t['text_oct_policy'] +'</div><button type="button" id="oct-policy-btn" class="button button-outline button-outline-primary button-small py-2 px-3 br-4">'+ t['oct_policy_accept'] +'</button></div></div></div></div></div>';

				$('body').append(html);

				$('#oct-policy-btn').on('click', function () {
					$('#oct-policy').addClass('hidden');
					const date = new Date(t['oct_policy_day_now'].replace(/-/g, "/"));
					date.setTime(date.getTime() + (t['oct_max_day'] * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
					document.cookie = t['oct_policy_value']+'=1; path=/; expires=' + date.toUTCString();
				});
			}
		},
		error: function(e, t, i) {
			console.log("error get_oct_policy");
		}
	});
}

$(function() {
	if (getOCTCookie('oct_policy') == 'undefined') {
		get_oct_policy();
	}
});
</script>
